text: Episode sixteen. When plans change. Setting a refund policy, and what it feels like to use it.
Every paid tier can carry its own refund policy. Let people cancel their own tickets, and set a deadline. Here, up to a day before.
Then decide what comes back. Everything a week out. Half of it two days out. Nothing after that. Save, and that's the rule for every ticket sold from now on.
As a buyer, you see those terms before you pay. Not after.
Something came up. Open the ticket and cancel it. The dialog tells you exactly what comes back, and until when. Card payments are refunded through Stripe, automatically.
On your side, the row says who cancelled and what was refunded. The seat is free again, and the numbers at the top already know.
And if the whole night has to go, one dialog cancels it, with a reason everyone sees, and refunds every ticket at once.
Plans change. The money and the message follow. Revel is free and open source. Find it at lets revel dot io.
